Found 23 items in registries @prompt-kit:

Showing items 1-23 of 23:

- prompt-input (registry:ui) - An input field designed for chat interfaces, allowing users to enter and submit text prompts to an AI model [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- code-block (registry:ui) - A component for displaying code snippets with syntax highlighting and customizable styling [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- markdown (registry:ui) - A component for rendering Markdown content with support for code blocks, GFM, and custom styling [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- message (registry:ui) - A component for displaying chat messages with support for avatars, markdown content, and interactive actions [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- chat-container (registry:ui) - A component for creating chat interfaces with intelligent auto-scrolling behavior, designed to provide a smooth and responsive user experience [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- scroll-button (registry:ui) - A floating button component that appears when users scroll up in a container, allowing them to quickly return to the bottom of the content [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- loader (registry:ui) - A component for displaying a loading indicator with multiple variants and customizable styling [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- prompt-suggestion (registry:ui) - A component for implementing interactive prompt suggestions in AI interfaces. The PromptSuggestion component offers two distinct modes: Normal Mode and Highlight Mode. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- response-stream (registry:ui) - A component to simulate streaming text on the client side, perfect for fake responses, or any controlled progressive text display. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- reasoning (registry:ui) - A collapsible component for showing AI reasoning, explanations, or logic. You can control it manually or let it auto-close when the stream ends. Markdown is supported. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- file-upload (registry:ui) - A component for creating drag-and-drop file upload interfaces with support for single or multiple files, custom triggers, and visual feedback during file dragging operations. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- jsx-preview (registry:ui) - A component for rendering JSX strings as React components, with support for streaming content and automatic tag completion. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tool (registry:ui) - Displays tool call details including input, output, status, and errors. Ideal for visualizing AI tool usage in chat UIs. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- source (registry:ui) - Displays website sources used by AI-generated content, showing URL details, titles, and descriptions on hover. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- image (registry:ui) - A component for displaying images from base64 or Uint8Array data, with full accessibility and responsive styling. Perfect for AI-generated or user-uploaded images. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- steps (registry:ui) - A component for displaying a sequence of operations in a collapsible layout. Each step can include details and an optional vertical bar. Useful for showing AI steps like reasoning traces, tool calls, or process logs. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- system-message (registry:ui) - A banner-style component for surfacing contextual information, warnings, or instructions within AI interfaces. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- chain-of-thought (registry:ui) - A component for displaying a chain of thought process with collapsible steps and triggers. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- text-shimmer (registry:ui) - A component for displaying a shimmer effect on text, perfect for loading states or highlighting text. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- thinking-bar (registry:ui) - A component to display the thinking state of an AI model with optional actions. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- feedback-bar (registry:ui) - A component to collect user feedback on AI responses. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- chatbot (registry:item) - A chatbot component that allows users to chat with an AI model. It uses prompt-kit, shadcn/ui, and AI SDK V5. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tool-calling (registry:item) - A chatbot with tool calling feature. It uses prompt-kit, shadcn/ui, and AI SDK V5. [@prompt-kit] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
